picture-pairs.name: Ol pija pea
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Gem blong Matching long ol adalt: Ol Pea blong Piksa
picture-pairs.h1: Ol pija pea: Wan kwaet gêm blong faenem sem pija
picture-pairs.description: Wan fri mo isi gem blong matching long ol adalt mo ol oldfala, inkludim ol man we oli gat dementia. Ol piksa oli save stap long skrin. No gat taem o skoa.
picture-pairs.short: Faenem tu pija we tufala i sem mak. Ol pija oli save stap soem olsem nomo.
picture-pairs.players: 1 o 2 man, stap saed long saed
picture-pairs.intro: Taepem wan pija, biaen taepem narawan we i sem mak long hem. Ol pija oli stap soem olsem nomo blong i no nid blong rimemba wan samting. Taem tu pija i kam wanples, tufala i kasem wan gol laen raonem olgeta mo wan mak blong tik.
howTo: Jusum hamas tael yu wantem yusum. Foa tael i wan kwaet ples blong stat.
Taepem eni pija. Wan gol laen bambae i kamaot raonem hem.
Taepem pija we i sem mak. Tufala pija ya bambae i stap wanples wetem wan mak blong tik.
Sipos tufala pija i no sem mak, i no gat wan nogud samting i hapen. Taepem bakegen taem yu rere.
Onem "Ol haed pija" nomo sipos yutufala i laekem fasin blong pas blong tanem pija i fesdaon.
tips: Singaot nem blong ol pija tugeta mo storian smol long olgeta: "Wan red kap ti. Yu stap putum melek long ti blong yu?"
Lekem man we yu stap lukaotem hem i taepem skrin, nomata i tekem smol taem. Poyntem nomo long fingga, no taepem long ples blong hem.
Stap wetem foa tael olsem we i harem gud. Moa tael i wan jus nomo, i no wan mak we yu mas kasem.
Finis taem yutufala i glad yet. Wan gêm nomo i wan ful aktiviti finis.

faq.q: I gat wan taem o mak blong gêm ya?
faq.a: No. I no gat klok, mak, namba blong kaontem ol muf, o fasin blong lus. Yu save stop long eni taem, mo blong stop hafwei i wan gudfala fasin blong finisim tu.

faq.q: From wanem ol pija oli stap soem fes blong olgeta oltaem?
faq.a: Taem ol pija oli stap soem, hemia i mekem gêm i kam blong lukluk mo faenem sem mak, i no blong rimemba samting. Plante man oli faenem se fasin ya i moa kwaet. Yu save jenisim i go long ol haed pija wetem wan taep nomo sipos yu wantem.

faq.q: Hemia i fri, mo mi nid blong saenap?
faq.a: Yes, hem i fri, mo i no gat akaon, saenap, o daonlod. Hem i wok gud long web braosa long fon, tablet, o kompiuta.

faq.q: Mifala i save yusum ol foto blong famili blong mifala?
faq.a: Yes. Traem Foto pea, we i letem yu jusum ol foto long divaes blong yu. Ol foto oli stap nomo long braosa blong yu mo oli no apload i go long naraples.

find-the-same.name: Faenem sem pija
find-the-same.seoTitle: Faendem sem piksa: Wan simpol gem blong piksa
find-the-same.description: Wan piksa i stap antap, mo tu o fo i stap aninit. Taj wan we i sem. Wan kuat mo fri gem blong piksa long ol adalt, ol oldfala mo famli, we i no gat taem.
find-the-same.short: Lukluk pija antap mo taepem pija we i sem mak daon.
find-the-same.intro: Wan pija nomo i stap antap long skrin. Daon long hem i gat tu, tri, o foa pija. Taepem pija we i sem mak. Hem i wan isi jus nomo long wan taem, wetem fulap taem blong toktok tugeta.

Lukluk pija antap tugeta.
Taepem pija we i sem mak daon. Bambae i gat wan mak blong tik mo sam kaen toktok i kamaot.
Sipos yu taepem wan narafala pija, gêm ya i talem nem blong hem nomo mo i wet. Tekem taem blong yu.
Taepem "Nekis pija" taem yu rere blong luk narafala.

Tu jus i no "isi tumas". Stael blong hem i blong harem gud long wan naes taem, i no blong givim hadwok.
Sipos i had blong taepem, man ya i save poyntem nomo mo yu save taepem long ples blong hem.

faq.a: I no gat wan samting we i mekem man i harem nogud. I no gat saon blong basa, red kros, o seking. Gêm i talem nem blong pija we yu taepem nomo mo i wet blong narafala taep.

four-together.name: Fo tugeta
four-together.seoTitle: Gem blong grupem piksa long ol adalt: Fo tugeta
four-together.h1: Fo tugeta: Wan kuat gem blong grupem piksa
four-together.description: Sam long ol piksa oli sem wan tema, olsem frut o weta. Taj ol piksa we oli go tugeta. Wan fri mo kuat gem blong grupem, we i no gat taem mo no gat skoa.
four-together.short: Faendem ol piksa we oli go tugeta, olsem frut o weta.
four-together.intro: Wan smol set blong ol piksa, mo sam long olgeta oli go tugeta: maybe fo kaen frut, o fo rod blong travel. Taj ol piksa we oli sem tema. Sipos wan piksa i go wetem narafala samting, gem ya i jes talemaot nem blong hem mo i waet. Afta wan taem i kwiet, wan hint i talemaot tema, mo “Soem grup” i soemaot ansa long eni taem.

Lukluk long ol piksa tugeta mo toktok long wanem we oli sem long hem.
Taj wan wan piksa we i belong long grup. Hem bae i gat gol bodo mo tik mak.

color-match.name: Color match
color-match.seoTitle: Color Match: wan gentel picture game
color-match.h1: Color Match: Faenem ol picture blong wan kala nomo
color-match.description: Wan bigfala kala wetem nem blong hem, mo fo o sikis picture. Tap evri picture we i sem kala wetem hem. Nogat taem, nogat score, mo narafala kala i nemem nomo. Fri blong pleiem mo prinaot.
color-match.short: Faenem evri picture we i sem kala wetem wan we i soem.
color-match.players: 1 o 2 man, o wan adalt mo wan pikinini
color-match.intro: Wan bigfala pis kala i soem wetem nem blong hem i raetem klosap long hem, mo i stap aninit long hem fo o sikis picture. Tap evri picture we i kala ya: wan red apol mo wan red kap, examp. Sipos wan picture i narafala kala, game bambae i nemem kala ya nomo ("The pear is green.") mo i wet. "Soem olgeta" i soem ol picture we i sem long taem we yu wantem, mo "Narafala kala" i go long nekis wan.
howTo: Jusum fo o sikis picture. Fo i isi moa.
Lukluk long kala ya mo ridim nem blong hem wetem wan wan.
Tap evri picture we i kala ya. Each wan bambae i gat wan thik boda mo wan chek mak.
Sipos wan picture i narafala kala, game bambae i talem wanem kala hem i gat mo i wet. Tekem taem blong yu.
Tap "Soem olgeta" taem we yu wantem, then "Narafala kala" blong wan nyufala kala.
tips: Talem kala ya long voes, then lukaraon long rum: wanem narafala samting i gat sem kala ya?
Yusum ol wod blong yu sipos yu wantem. "Tomato" o "sky" i gud sem olsem "red" o "blue".
Pointing i wok sem olsem tap. Sidaon wan saet long narafala blong yufala i save lukim skrin.

faq.q: Wanem bambae i hapen sipos wan picture blong narafala kala i tap?
faq.a: Nogat samting we i no gud. Nogat buzzer, red cross o shekem. Game bambae i nemem picture mo kala blong hem, olsem "The pear is green.", mo i wet long nekis tap.

faq.q: Kala nomo i wan klu?
faq.a: Nogat. Kala i soem olsem wan bigfala pis mo tu i raetem olsem wan wod, mo evri picture i nemem taem i tap. Sam man we i hadwe blong lukim kala i save pleiem yet long we i ridim nem ya.

halves-match.seoTitle: Halves Match: wan gentel picture game

color-by-number.name: Kala long namba
color-by-number.seoTitle: Kala long namba: Wan Gem blong Fulumap wetem Lafet we i Kwiet
color-by-number.h1: Kala long namba: Fulumap ol skwea, wetem kala we yu laekem
color-by-number.description: Wan grid blong bigfala skwea we i gat namba, mo wan kae blong fo kala wetem nem blong olgeta. Jusum wan kala, afta tajem ol skwea blong fulumap. Enikaen kala i naes, i no gat taem o skoa, mo wan batan i fulumap ol narafala skwea i go long namba. I fri blong pleiem mo prentem.
color-by-number.short: Jusum wan kala, afta tajem ol skwea we i gat namba blong fulumap olgeta.
color-by-number.intro: Wan skwea gird blong bigfala skwea, wan-wan i gat namba, mo wan kae i stap antap long hem wetem fo kala, wan-wan i gat namba mo nem blong hem long raet. Jusum wan kala long kae, afta tajem ol skwea blong fulumap. Gird i 4 bae 4 long fastaem, mo 6 bae 6 mo 8 bae 8 sipos yu wantem moa skwea. Taem evri skwea i gat kala blong namba blong hem, gird i kam pikja we i stap long pepa. Ol skwea we i gat ol narafala kala, i jis pikja blong yu wan, mo gem ya i no talem enisamting long hem. "Fulumap wetem ol namba" i fulumap evri skwea we i no gat kala, long yu.
howTo: Jusum saes blong gird. 4 bae 4 i gat ol bigfala skwea mo hem i isi moa.
Lukluk long kae we i stap antap long gird. Wan-wan kala i gat namba mo nem, olsem 1 Yelo.
Tajem wan kala long kae, afta tajem ol skwea we yu wantem fulumap wetem hem.
Yusum kala we i stap long namba, o enikaen kala we yu laekem. Tufala i naes.
Tajem "Fulumap wetem ol namba" blong ol skwea we i no gat kala, "Klia" blong statem gird bakegen, o "Narafala pikja" blong wan narafala pikja.
tips: Sitdaon seraot mo jenjenem tenem: wan man i jusum kala, narafala i tajem skwea.
Toktok abaot ol kala: "Mi laekem grin." I no nid blong talem wanem pikja bae i kam.
Long wan narod skrin, gird 8 bae 8 i muvum saet long bokis blong hem. Ol skwea i stap long saes we i isi.
Vesen long pepa i wok sem wetem pensol long wan tebol klosap long bed.

faq.q: I gat taem o skoa?
faq.a: No. I no gat klok, skoa, kaonta blong muv o lusum. Yu save stopem long eni taem, mo stopem long haf i wan gud rod blong finisim.

faq.q: Wat sipos mi yusum wan narafala kala from namba?
faq.a: I no gat wan samting we i hapen, mo dat i wanem we i minim. Eni kala i save go long eni skwea, mo gem i no talemaot enisamting long hem. Taem evri skwea i gat kala blong namba blong hem, gem i talem long wan sof wei, mo pikja long ol kala blong yu wan i sem nomo i gud.

faq.q: Ol man we oli no save luk ol kala i save distinguish ol fo kala ya?
faq.a: Ol kala ya oli bin jusum blong oli save. Evri kala i gat tu namba, nem long raet mo wan smol sep blong hem, so kala i no wan nomo wei blong distinguish. Ol fo fil oli bin jekem wetem simulesen blong blaendnes long red mo grin, mo blu mo yelo, mo oli defren tu long laet. Wan man we i no save luk ol kala i no yet traem olgeta, so plis talemaot long mifala sipos tu i luk sem.

faq.q: Ol skwea i bigfala enaf blong wan handabeat o smol skrin?
faq.a: Evri skwea i sem 48 pikisel i wael long las, mo 56 long gird 4 bae 4. Sipos wan gird i tu wael blong skrin, i muvum saet long bokis blong hem, i no smolem ol skwea.

faq.q: I gat wan vesen long pepa?
faq.a: Ya. Wan pes pepa i gat wan gird we i gat namba mo kae blong fo kala wetem nem blong olgeta. Kalemap evri skwea wetem pensol blong kala we i stap long namba blong hem, o eni kala we yu laekem.

faq.q: I fri, mo mi nidim blong rejista?
faq.a: Ya, i fri, mo i no nidim akaont, rejistreson o download. I save wok long web browser long fon, tablet o kompiuta.

pattern-maker.name: Pattern mekem
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern Mekem: Dizaenem wan Tael mo Prentem Pattern
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern Mekem: Dizaenem wan Tael, mo lukem i ripitim
pattern-maker.description: Jenjenem ol skwea blong wan smol tael mo lukem i ripitim i kam wan pattern klosap, long fo kala we wan-wan i gat nem mo sep blong hem. I no gat taem o skoa. I fri blong pleiem mo prentem.
pattern-maker.short: Jenjenem ol skwea blong wan smol tael mo lukem i ripitim i kam wan pattern.
pattern-maker.intro: Wan smol tael blong 3 bae 3 skwea, o 4 bae 4 sipos yu wantem, mo klosap long hem "pattern blong yu": sem tael ya i ripitim long wan blok. Tajem wan skwea mo hem i jenisem i go long nekis long fo kala, wan-wan i gat nem long raet mo sep blong hem. Pattern klosap i jenisem long wan taem. I no gat rong pattern mo nating i sevem o i sendem. "Prentem pattern blong mi" i putum pattern we i ripitim long wan pes pepa blong yu kipim, kalemap o givim.
howTo: Lukluk long tael mo long pattern blong yu klosap long hem. Olgeta i sem tael, we i ripitim.
Tajem wan skwea. I jenisem i go long nekis kala long raes blong fo kala antap.
Tajem ol skwea i go on kasem taem pattern i lukluk olsem wanem yu wantem. Eni pattern i gud.
Tajem "Surpraes mi" blong wan niu tael, o "Statem bakegen" blong wan klia. "Putumbak" i kasem bakegen tael we yu bin gat.
Tajem "Prentem pattern blong mi" sipos yu wantem long pepa, o tajem Rest blong stopem.
tips: Sidaon long saed blong narafala mo jenisim turn: wan man i tajem wan skwea, mo narafala i talem wanem hem i notisim.
Talem wanem yu lukim: "Hemia i luk olsem wan flaoa." No nid blong nemem eni samting.
Traem sem tile ia long tu kala nomo, afta long ol fo kala.
Long pepa, pattern ia i save kalarem wetem pensol, katem i kam long ol strip blong wan kad, o yusum blong raepem wan smol presen.

faq.q: I gat taem o skoa?
faq.a: No. I no gat klok, skoa, kaonta blong muv o lusum. Yu save stopem long eni taem, mo stopem long haf wei hemi wan gud rod blong finisim.

faq.q: Eni samting we mi mekem i sevem o i sendem?
faq.a: No. Tile blong yu i stap nomo long pej ia. I no sevem, i no apload, i no kaontem, mo hemi lus taem yu lokemaot pej. Sapos yu wantem kipim pattern, prentem i.

faq.q: Wanem sapos mi tajem rong skwea, o mi klirim tile bifo mi wantem?
faq.a: I no gat rong skwea: tajem i bak blong go long kala we i nekis. Afta long "Stat bakegen" o "Givim mi wan surprais", "Putum bak" i kasem bak tile we yu bin gat.

faq.q: Ol man we oli no save lukim kala gud oli save distingwishim ol kala ia?
faq.a: Ol kala ia oli bin jusum blong mekem olsem. Long eni kala i gat nem we oli raetem, mo long ol skwea i gat wan smol saep blong hem, so kala nomo i no wan rod blong distingwishim. Ol fo kala oli bin jekem wetem ol simuleisen blong red-grin mo blu-yelo blaenes long kala. Wan man we i gat blaenes long kala i no yet traem ol kala ia, so plis talem mifala sapos tu long olgeta i luk olsem.

faq.q: Ol skwea i bigwan blong ol man we han blong olgeta i shakem, o blong smol skrin?
faq.a: Evri skwea i bigwan 56 pixel nomo. Sapos tile i tumas bigwan blong skrin, hem i ranem sed-wei insaed long bokis blong hem, i no smolem ol skwea.

faq.q: I gat pepa version?
faq.a: Yes. "Prentem pattern blong mi" i prentem pattern we yu mekem long wan pej, wetem ol fo kala mo nem blong olgeta. Hemi gud tu long blak mo waet, from long eni kala i gat saep blong hem wan.

faq.q: Hemi free, mo yu nidim sign up?
faq.a: Yes, hemi free, mo i no gat akaont, sign-up, o download. Hemi wok long web browser long fon, tablet, o kompyuta.

drawing-duet.name: Drowing duet
drawing-duet.seoTitle: Drawing Duet: Tu Man, Wan Pija
drawing-duet.h1: Drawing Duet: Tu Man, Wan Pepa
drawing-duet.description: Tu man i tekem turn blong drowem laen long wan kanvas we oli sherem, wan-wan i yusum kala blong hem. I no gat man we i skoa o i win, mo yu save sevem o prentem pija ia. Hemi free blong pleiem, no nid akaont.
drawing-duet.short: Tekem turn blong drowem wan pija we yu sherem wetem man we i sidaon long saed blong yu.
drawing-duet.intro: Wan kanvas, tu man. Wan-wan long yu i jusum wan kala, mo long kala i gat nem we oli raetem. Yu tekem turn: drowem wan laen o wan saep, then pasem pen. Eni long yu i save pasem long eni taem. I no gat rong pija mo i no gat skoa. Sevem pija long divaes blong yu sapos yu laekem, o prentem pepa version: wan pepa, tu pen.
howTo: Wan-wan long yu i jusum wan kala. Banner i talem whose turn hem, wetem kala blong man ia long nem.
Drowem wan laen o wan saep wetem finga, mauss o pen. O yusum arrow key mo Space blong drowem nating pointer.
Taem yu redi, tajem "Pasem pen". Eni long yu i save pasem long eni taem.
Tajem "Tekem bak las laen blong mi" blong rimivum niu laen blong man we i gat turn.
Tajem "Sevem pija" blong mekem wan pija fael long divaes ia, o "Prentem pepa version" blong wan pepa mo tu pen.
tips: Sidaon long saed blong narafala mo toktok taem yu drowem: "Bambae mi putum wan san long kona."
Statem wetem wan dot, wan laen o wan simpol saep, mo letem narafala i ansarem.
Nating man i nid blong drowem wan pija blong wanem samting. Wan pattern blong laen i gud sem olsem wan sen.
Sapos yu wantem stopem, tajem "Pinis fo nao". Pija blong yu i no stap afta yu lusum pej, sapos yu no sevem i.

faq.q: I gat winman o skoa?
faq.a: No. I no gat winman, no skoa, no taem, no kaonta blong ol turn. I no gat rong pija, mo nating i ranem o kompea.

faq.q: Pija i sevem o i sendem?
faq.a: No, nating i sendem i go eniwea. Pija i stap long pej ia kasem yu lokemaot pej. Sapos yu tajem "Sevem pija", wan fael bai i mekem long divaes blong yu blong yu daonlodem. Nating i apload.

faq.q: Yu save tekem bak wan laen?
faq.a: Yes. "Tekem bak las laen blong mi" i rimivum niu laen blong man we i gat turn. "Stat bakegen" i kliarem pepa, mo "Putum bak" i kasem ol laen bak, wan step nomo.

faq.q: Yu save yusum ia taem i no gat maos o tajskrin?
faq.a: Yes. Taem drowing i gat fokes, ol arrow key i muvum wan dot blong pen, mo Space key i putum pen daon o antap. Skrin i talem "Pen daon" o "Pen antap" evri taem.

faq.q: Ol kala ia oli wanem, mo ol man we oli no save lukim kala gud oli save distingwishim?
faq.a: Yelo, oren, grin mo pepol, ol sem fo kala we ol nara pija gem blong mifala i yusum. Long eni kala i gat nem we oli raetem, mo ol nem i sho long saed blong turn. Ol kala ia oli bin jekem wetem ol simuleisen blong ol komon defren blong luk kala, bat wan man we i gat defren blong luk kala i no yet traem.

faq.q: I gat pepa version?
faq.a: Yes. "Prentem pepa version" i prentem wan pepa wetem ol rul we i stap long hem, mo wan bigfala blank frem blong drowem insaed, blong tu man wetem tu pen. I wok long blak mo waet tu.

faq.q: Hemi free, mo yu nidim sign up?
faq.a: Ya, hem i fri, mo i no nid blong opening akaon, sign-up, o download. I wokem long web browser long fon, tablet o komputa.

build-together.name: Build together
build-together.seoTitle: Build Together: Tufala Man i Wokem Wan Pattern
build-together.h1: Build Together: Tufala Man, Wan Grid
build-together.description: Tufala man i tanem tano blong putum wan pis long wan grid we i tuwe blong olgeta, kasem i fulap, long wan kala blong olgeta we i gat nem mo sep blong hem. Nobodi i win, mo i no gat taem o skor. Fri blong pleiem mo printem.
build-together.short: Tanem tano wetem wan man we i sidaon klosap blong fulumap wan grid we tufala i wokem tugeta.
build-together.players: 2 man, sidaon klosap long wan narafala
build-together.intro: Wan grid we i gat 4 x 4 ples, o 3 x 3 sipos yu laek. Yumi wan-wan i jusum wan kala, mo kala blong wan-wan i gat nem we i rait i stap mo sep blong hem. Yumi tanem tano: long tano blong yu, tajem wan ples we i empty blong putum pis blong yu long hem. Taem evri ples i gat wan pis, pikja i wokem tugeta. I no gat wan we i win, from yumi wokem long pea, mo nating i sevem o sendem. "Print the grid" i putum wan empty grid long wan pej blong yu save wokem wetem tu pensol.
howTo: Yumi wan-wan i jusum wan kala. Kala we narafala man i yusum finis i gat maak "In use".
Man we i fastaem i go fast. Skrin i talem we nao i tano blong hu mo kala blong hem i wanem.
Tajem wan empty ples blong putum pis blong yu long hem. Tano i pas i go long narafala man.
Sipos yu no wantem putum pis, tajem "Pass". Eni wan long yumi i save pass long eni taem.
Taem evri ples i gat pis, yu wokem pikja tugeta finis. Tajem "Start again" blong wokem narafala, o tajem Rest blong stopem.
tips: Sidaon klosap blong yumi tufala i save luk mo kasem skrin. Toktok long wei we yu stap wokem: "Mi bae putum long kolsap long yu."
Traem blong wokem wan pattern, ol strip, wan checkerboard o wan border, o putum pis nomata wea yu laekem. Tufala i stret.
Pikinini o man we i kwik i ted i save pass planti taem we i laekem. Pikja i stap wokem tugeta yet.
Long pepa, wan-wan i yusum wan pensol mo i draem sep blong hem long ol empty skwea.

faq.q: I gat wan we i win, taem, o skor?
faq.a: Nogat. I no gat wan we i win, from yumi wokem wan pikja tugeta. I no gat klok, skor, namba blong pis, o lusum. Yu save stopem long eni taem, mo stopem long hafwe i wan gud wei blong finisim.

faq.q: Eni samting we mifala i wokem i sevem o sendem?
faq.a: Nogat. Grid i stap long dis pej nomo. I no sevem, i no apload, mo i no kaontem, mo i go nating taem yu lokem pej. Sipos yu laek kipim, prinem grid mo wokem long pepa.

faq.q: Wat sipos mi putum pis long rong ples?
faq.a: I no gat rong ples. Tajem "Take back the last piece" mo tano i go bak long yu. Yu save tekem bak wan stap wan taem, mo pas tu i save tekem bak.

faq.q: Ol fo kala ya i save stap klia long ol man we oli no save luk kala gud?
faq.a: Oli jusum from oli save. Evri kala i gat tu nem we i rait mo wan smol sep blong hem long wan-wan pis, so kala i no nomo wei blong tuwe olgeta. Ol fo kala ya oli bin jekem wetem ol simulesen blong red-green mo blue-yellow kala blaendnes. Wan man we i no save luk kala gud i no yet traem olgeta, so plis talem mifala sipos tu long olgeta i olsem.

faq.q: Ol ples i bigwan från tremor o smol skrin?
faq.a: Evri ples i wan 56 pixel i bigwan longfala. Sipos grid i tumas wael long skrin, i muv sae long bokis blong hem, nao i no skrinkem ol ples.

faq.q: I gat pepa vesen?
faq.a: I gat. "Print the grid" i prinem wan empty grid long wan pej, wetem tufala kala mo nem blong olgeta, blong wokem wetem tu pensol. I wok long blak mo waet from evri kala i gat sep blong hem.

faq.q: I fri, mo mi nidim sign up?
faq.a: Ya, hem i fri, mo i no nid blong opening akaon, sign-up, o download. I wokem long web browser long fon, tablet o komputa.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: Gem blong Tufala long Bean-Bag
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Tufala Man i Tro Tugeta long Tebol
seated-toss.description: Tufala man i sidaon long wan tebol i tanem tano blong tro wan soft bean bag i go long wan bigfala target mo i kipim tally long pepa. Nating taem o skor i stap. Fri blong printem.
seated-toss.short: Tanem tano blong tro wan bean bag i go long wan bigfala target, mo tally i stap long pepa.
seated-toss.intro: Wan gem blong tro we i kwaet blong tufala man we i sidaon long wan tebol. Yu putum wan printed target long tebol mo yumi tanem tano blong tro wan soft bean bag, o wan sok we i rol, blong i fol long ol ring. Wan-wan i kipim tally long bokis long pepa, mo taem yu stopem, yumi lukluk tugeta long ol tik. Nating taem i stap, nating i ademap long skrin, mo nating i sevem o sendem. Plis ridim ol sefti nod fastaem: ol smol filing i save kasem man i no save win.
howTo: Ridim ol sefti nod. Jusum wan bag we i sew finis long ol saed, o rolum wan klin sok.
Tajem "Print the target and tally sheet" mo putum sit ya i fleta long tebol long wiken yumi tufala.
Sidaon i gud, wan long wan saed, mo tanem tano blong wan-wan i tro wan slow tro. Eni wan i save pass.
Taem tro i fol long wan ring, tik wan bokis long kolam blong yu, long rop blong ring ya.
Lukluk ol tik tugeta taem yu stopem, o tajem Rest blong pausem.
tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ce ya i gud wan." Evriwan i save yu long evri toss.
Wan rolled-up sok i laet and i isi blong holem wetem wik grip. Putum wan han long tebol long taem blong eni wan blong wok.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack
seasonal-pack.seoTitle: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Printable Paper Puzzles
seasonal-pack.h1: Seasonal Puzzle Pack: Three Paper Puzzles for Each Season
seasonal-pack.description: Three small printable puzzles for spring, summer, autumn or winter: match the pairs, circle the one that is different, and color a picture in. Choose a season, or take a rest day. Free to print.
seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.
seasonal-pack.players: All ages, solo or side by side
seasonal-pack.intro: Choose a season, and the page shows three small paper puzzles drawn from that season's pictures: two rows to join with lines, a row of four to circle the one that is different, and a picture to color in. You print one page, then do one, two or all three, at your own pace. Choose "Today is a rest day" instead and there is nothing to do.
howTo: Choose a season, or choose "Today is a rest day".
Look at the three puzzles, then tap "Print this season's pack".
Do one, two or all three, at your own pace.
Join the matching pictures with a line, circle the one that is different, and color the large picture in.
Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Chagua okesen, then tap "Print the card".
Foldem sit long hafwe along the dashed line, so the front i stap aotsaed.
Wan man i dekoretem front, mo narafala i dekoretem back, o yufala i jenjenem long wan saed.
Raet wan mesej tugeta. Wan man i save raet, mo narafala i save talem ol wot.
Stopem taem yu laekem. Wan simpol kad i gud jes olsem wan we i gat plante dwaen.
tips: Stat wetem ol wot long front, then ad lif, stA o dot raon long olgeta, wan wan.
Sipos wan man i no laek dro, hem i save jusem ol kala o raetem mesej.
Talem wot yu laekem long ol mak blong narafala man, nogat talem sipos oli gud o nogat.
Putum kad long ples we i save givim, o jes holem long tebol long taem ya.

faq.q: I gat taem o skoa?
faq.a: Nogat. I no gat klok, skoa, kaonta blong muv, o lusim. Yu save stopem long eni taem, mo stopem long hafwe i wan gud we blong finisim.

faq.q: Yumi nidim glu, sisa o stika?
faq.a: Nogat. Kreyon, kala pensol o felt-tip pen i enaf. I no nid blong katem, glu o stikem eni samting.

faq.q: Iumi save mekem kad blong wan okesen we i no stap long lis?
faq.a: Chusum "Just because" mo raetem ol aword blong yu long front, o jes dekoretem kad ya nogat wan okesen.

faq.q: I gat eni samting we i kaontem, jajem o sevem long skrin?
faq.a: Nogat. Pej ya i jes soem kad mo ol step. I no gat eni samting we i ranem, skoremem o sevem, mo i no gat wan rong kad.

faq.q: Wanem i stap long printed sheet?
faq.a: Wan pej: wan kad we i fodem hafwe, wetem ol wot blong okesen mo wan simpol frem long front, mo ol lain blong mesej mo wan From lain long back. Ol rul blong tufala man i printim long botom.

faq.q: Hem i fri, mo yu nidim sainap?
faq.a: Yes, hem i fri, mo i no gat akaont, sainap o daonlod. I wok long web browser long fon, tablet o komputa.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Tufala Man i Faendem ol Pea
find-together.h1: Find Together: Tufala Man, Wan Tim
find-together.description: Tufala man i sherem wan skrin mo oli jenjenem blong tanem tufala piksa kad blong lukaotem wan pea. Ol pea oli faendem tugeta mo oli kaontem long wan sheda tali. Fri blong pleim, nogat taem o skoa.
find-together.short: Jenjenem wetem wan man we i sidaon klosap blong faendem ol piksa pea.
find-together.intro: Ol kad oli stat wetem ol piksa blong olgeta i soem, o yu save putum olgeta i fes daon. Long taem blong yu, yu tanem tu kad. Sipos oli pea, yu faendem tugeta mo taem i pas i go long narafala. Sipos oli defren, oli stap i fesap kasem yu pressem "Turn them back", blong tufala save lukluk. Yu save pass long eni taem. Tali we i stap antap i go hae nomo: ol pea we yu faendem tugeta.
howTo: Chusum hamas kad blong yusum. Sikis kad, tri pea, hem i wan kuiet ples blong stat.
Skrin i talem husat i stap long taem, wetem wan sekol blong fast man mo wan skwea blong seken man.
Tanem tu kad, wan afta narafala. Sipos oli matjem, pea i faendem tugeta.
Sipos oli defren, pressem "Turn them back" taem yu tufala i redi. Taem i pas i go long narafala.
Eni long yu i save pressem "Pass" long eni taem. Tapem "Start again" blong ol niu kad, o tapem Rest blong stopem.
tips: Sidaon klosap mo talem ol piksa long vois tugeta: "Wan kap blong ti. Yu wantem milk long ti blong yu?"
Letem man we yu kea long hem i tapem, even sipos i tekem taem. Pointem i gud moa, i no tapem blong hem.
Chusum "Cards face down" sipos tufala i laekem tanem kad blong faendem ol piksa.
Wan man we i kaen kwik i save pass taem i fes blong hem. Ol pea oli stap faendem tugeta.

faq.q: I gat wan winner, taem o skoa?
faq.a: Nogat. I no gat winner, from yumi faendem ol pea olsem wan tim. I no gat klok, skoa, mo i no kaontem ol miss. Tali i kaontem jes ol pea we yu faendem tugeta, mo yu save stopem long eni taem.

picture-bingo.description: Free printable picture bingo for families, senior groups and care homes. Big pictures with words, 9 or 16 squares, and a large on-screen caller.
picture-bingo.short: Ol kad blong bingo blong peksa we yu save printim mo skrin blong kolem peksa blong ol grup.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo we i yusum peksa be i no namba, mekem se i no gat man i nid blong ridim ol smol leta. Printim ol kad we oli no semak, biaen yusum skrin blong kolem peksa blong soemaot bigwan long wan televisin, laptop o tablet.
howTo: Jusum 9 o 16 skwea long wan kad mo hamas man bae i plei.
Tajem "Print cards". Wanwan kad i defren.
Opnem skrin blong kolem peksa long wan bigfala skrin. Tajem "Next picture" blong soemaot wanwan peksa wetem nem blong hem.
Ol man we oli plei oli kavremap peksa we i semak long kad blong olgeta wetem wan selen, baten o maka.
Evriwan we i fulumap wan laen, o ful kad, oli glad wetem olgeta. I no gat man i lus long fasin ya: gohed blong plei kasem we evriwan i gat wan laen.
tips: Yusum ol bigfala samting olsem kokonas sel, brikis o tap blong botel. Ol smol baten oli save had blong pikimap.
Kolem nem blong peksa mo talem wan samting long hem: "Wan bot we i gat sel. Hu i bin go aot long bot bifo?"
Putum olgeta we ae blong olgeta i no lukluk klia klosap moa long skrin, mo putum ol halpa wetem ol man we oli nidim help.
Naen skwea i naf gud long plante grup. Mekem taem ya i stap raonabaot 20 kasem 30 minit.

faq.q: Olsem wanem nao mi save mekem bingo blong peksa insaed long wan haos blong lukaotem ol olfala?
faq.a: Printim wan kad long wanwan man we i plei, putum skrin blong kolem peksa long bigfala skrin we yu gat, mo kolem ol peksa sloslo, wetem nem blong olgeta. Plei go kasem we evriwan i kasem wan laen, blong no gat man i stap biaen.

faq.q: I fri nomo blong printim?
faq.a: Yes. Yu save printim hamas kad we yu nidim, plante taem we yu wantem, blong yu wan o blong grup.

faq.q: Ol man oli save plei nomata oli no save rid?
faq.a: Yes. Wanwan skwea i gat wan bigfala peksa, wetem nem blong hem aninit blong olgeta we oli laekem ol wod.

picnic-planner.name: Picnic planner
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures for an Outing
picnic-planner.h1: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures, Then Match Them
picnic-planner.description: Choose food and things-to-do pictures for a picnic, then play a gentle matching round with them. Nothing is timed. Free to play and print.
picnic-planner.short: Pick food and outing pictures for a picnic, then match them.
picnic-planner.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
picnic-planner.intro: Tap ol fotograf blong kakae mo ol samting blong duim, blong putum oli insaed long wan picnic basket, we i holem sikis samting. Wan sentens long ol wod i talem wet i stap insaed long basket, olsem "Picnic blong mifala: bred, sis, aples mo wan kaet." Afta, tap "Let's play with our picnic" blong wan gentol matching raon we i kamaot long ol fotograf we yu jusum. Ol fotograf oli stap oltaem i soem, mo nating i stap blong taemem, skorem o sevem. "Print our picnic list" i prin wan jeklist blong wat yu jusum, wetem wan boks blong tik long each samting blong pakem.
howTo: Tap wan fotograf blong kakae o wan samting blong duim. Hem bae go insaed long basket.
Tap wan fotograf insaed long basket blong tekemaot hem gen.
Jusum at least tu samting, then tap "Let's play with our picnic".
Tap tu fotograf we oli sem. Ol fotograf oli stap i soem, so i no nidim yu tingting blong rimemba enikaen samting.
Tap "Print our picnic list" blong wan pepa jeklist blong tekem wetem yu.
tips: Askem ol man we yu stap wetem wat oli wantem blakem, mo jusum ol fotograf tugeta.
Toktok long ankae fotograf taem hem go insaed: "Yu rimembarem kaet we mifala flae long bij?"
Long pepa, ol blank lain oli blong eni narafala samting we yu wantem blakem, o blong wan nem.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nating i taemem, nating i kaontem, mo no wan i win. Matching raon ia i no gat miss mo no gat pointis.

faq.q: Is this a meal plan?
faq.a: No. Hem wan fotograf plan blong wan autting, blong toktok long hem mo blong tekem long pepa. Hem no talem wat wan man i shud kakae.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. Basket ia i stap long page ia nomo. Hem no sef, no upload, no sendem, mo hem bae go taem yu klosem page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print our picnic list" i prin wan page nomo, long A4 o US Letter. Hem i soem ol fotograf we yu jusum, wetem wan boks blong tik long each wan, mo ol blank lain blong eni narafala samting.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, hem fri, mo i no nidim akaont, sainap o download. Hem i wok long web browser long fon, tablet o kompiuta.

scrapbook.name: Scrapbook
scrapbook.seoTitle: Scrapbook: Turn Family Photos Together, Page by Page
scrapbook.h1: Scrapbook: Add Your Photos and Captions, Then Turn the Pages
scrapbook.description: Choose two to twelve of your own family photos on your device and turn them as a book, with a few words under each. Nothing is uploaded. Free to print.
scrapbook.short: Page through your own family photos together, like a book.
scrapbook.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
scrapbook.intro: Jusum 2 to 12 ol fotograf blong yu long dis divaes. Wan fotograf i kam wan page blong wan buk, i bigfala nao blong ol man i save luk, wetem optional sam wod andanit long hem. Turnem ol page wetem ol button o ol arrow key, mo yusum "Look together" blong sidaon wetem ol fotograf mo ol wod nomo. Ol fotograf blong yu i stap long divaes ia. Oli no upload o sev, mo buk ia i go taem yu klosem page. "Print the scrapbook" i prin wan fotograf mo ol wod blong hem long each page, wetem ol namba blong page.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" mo jusum 2 to 12 fotograf. Askem fastaem sipos yu wantem yusum fotograf blong wan man we i no inap talem yes.
Turnem ol page wetem "Previous page" mo "Next page", o wetem Left mo Right arrow key.
Putum sam wod andanit long wan fotograf sipos yu wantem. Yusum "Move earlier" o "Move later" blong jenjem orda.
Tap "Look together" blong haedem ol editing kontrol mo lukluk long buk wetem yu sidaon klosap.
Tap "Print the scrapbook" blong wan pepa kopi, o "Clear the book" taem yu finis. Nating i stap.
tips: Valitim ol foto blong samting we oli glad mo oli fala: wan gaden, wan pet, wan ples we i stap gud long hem. Talem abaot eni pej taem yu turnem.
Lukaotem se man ya o woman ya i save talem sam wod long eni pej, nating i wan wod nomo, mo raetem olgeta exactli olsem we hem i talem.
Long pepa, ol printed pej oli save go insaed long wan fail, mo famle i save putum olgeta pikjas blong olgeta mo nout raon olgeta.

faq.q: I gat taem, skor o wanem winnaer?
faq.a: Nogat. Nating i gat taem, skor o kaontem, mo nobodi i winim. Namba blong pej i stap nomo blong yu save we yu stap long wanem pej long buk.

faq.q: Ol foto mo ol nout blong yumi i stap seivum, apload o sendem?
faq.a: Nogat. Pej ya nomo i ridim ol foto, mo ol foto oli no apload, no stoa o sendem i go eni ples. Ol nout oli stap nomo taem pej ya i open. Taem yu lokem pej, buk ya i lus.

faq.q: Yumi save printem buk ya?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the scrapbook" i printem wan foto mo nout blong hem long wan pej, wetem namba blong pej. Long print dialog, yu save jusim A4 o US Letter.

faq.q: I free ka, mo yu nidim saen-ap?
faq.a: Yes, i free, mo i no nidim akaont, saen-ap o daonlod. I wok long web braosa long fon, tablet o kompiuta.

collage-board.name: Collage bod
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage Bod: Tufala Man o Woman i Putum Pikjas long Turn
collage-board.h1: Collage Bod: Putum Pikjas long Wan Bod, long Turn
collage-board.description: Tufala man o woman i putum ol kat-aot pikjas long wan bod we tufala i sheswan. Tapim wan kat-aot, then wan ples we i nogat wanfala. Nogat taem o skor. Free blong pleyem mo printem.
collage-board.short: Putum pikjas long wan bod we tufala i sheswan, long turn.
collage-board.players: 2 man o woman, sidaed long side
collage-board.intro: Tufala man o woman i sidaon long side, wetem wan bod we i gat tuelv ples mo wan tre we i gat eit kat-aot pikjas. Tapim wan kat-aot, then tapim wan ples we i nogat samting, mo pikja ya i go long hem. Then turn i pasem long narafala man o woman. Pikjas blong wan man o woman i gat fom blong olgeta, wan saknel o wan skwea, so bod ya i soem hu i putum wanem, i no bisaed long kala. Eni man o woman i save pas, mo wan step i save bakegen. Nating i gat taem, skor o seivum. "Print the board" i printem bod we i no gat eni samting mo ol pikjas blong katem.
howTo: Tapim wan kat-aot long tre. I soem "Chosen" taem i selektem.
Tapim wan ples we i nogat samting long bod. Kat-aot i go long hem, mo turn i pasem.
Eni man o woman i save tapim Pass long eni taem, o "Take back the last piece" blong andu wan step.
Tapim "Another set of pictures" blong gat narafala tre. Ol pikjas we i already long bod bae oli stap long ples blong olgeta.
Tapim "Start again" blong klirem bod, mo "Put it back" sapos yu jenisem tingting blong yu.
tips: Talem nem blong wan wan pikja taem i go daon, olsem "the teacup goes by the house". Toktok i mekem it wan samfala aktiviti.
Letem tufala man o woman i jusum kat-aot mo ples tugeta, blong olgeta tufala i gat tingting blong olgeta.
Long pepa, katem eit pikjas wetem wan adalt i helpem, then putum olgeta long ol boks we i printed.

faq.q: I gat taem, skor o wanem winnaer?
faq.a: Nogat. Nating i gat taem, skor o kaontem, mo nobodi i winim. Bod we i fulap i jes wan we i gat pikja long evri ples.

faq.q: Ol pikjas we yumi putum i stap seivum o sendem?
faq.a: Nogat. Bod i stap long pej ya nomo. I no stap seivum, apload o kaontem, mo i lus taem yu lokem pej.

faq.q: Hao nao yumi save luksavvi pikja blong wan man o woman?
faq.a: Wan wan man o woman i gat fom blong olgeta. Pikjas blong fastfala man o woman i gat wan saknel long kona, mo blong sekondfala i gat wan skwea, wetem nem blong olgeta i soem antap long bod.

faq.q: I gat wan pepa wosen?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the board" i printem bod we i no gat eni samting olsem tuelv boks, wetem eit pikjas i stap daon long sem saes, mo lukem ples blong katem. Wan adalt i save katem.

faq.q: I free ka, mo yu nidim saen-ap?
faq.a: Yes, i free, mo i no nidim akaont, saen-ap o daonlod. I wok long web braosa long fon, tablet o kompiuta.

garden-planner.name: Gaden planner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Gaden Planner: Putum Plan blong Plot long Pikjas blong Plant
garden-planner.h1: Gaden Planner: Jusum Pikjas mo Putum Plan blong Plot
garden-planner.description: Jusum pikjas blong ol plant mo ol samting blong gaden, then putum olgeta long tuelv bed blong wan plot. Tapim wan pikja, then wan bed. Nogat taem o skor. Free blong pleyem mo printem.
garden-planner.short: Jusum pikjas blong plant mo putum plan blong wan plot we i gat tuelv bed.
garden-planner.players: Wan wan, o 2 man o woman sidaed long side
garden-planner.intro: Jusum pikjas long tre we i gat ol plant mo ol samting blong gaden, then tapim wan bed blong putum wan wan long ples blong hem. Wan plot i gat tuelv bed, mo wan bed i holem wan pikja nomo. Wan samari long wod i talem wetem plan i gat wanem, olsem "Plan blong yu i gat 3 sanflaoa, 2 rous mo 1 tri." Nating i gat taem, skor o seivum, mo i no gat turn. Hem i wan pikja plan blong toktok long hem, i no advaes blong planting. "Print the plan" i printem ol bed wetem ol pikja we yu jusum, wetem ol bed we i empty blong draw long hem mo ol laen blong nout.
howTo: Tapim wan pikja long tre. I soem "Chosen" taem i selektem.
Tapim wan bed. Pikja i go long hem, mo jus i stap.
Blong jenisem wan bed, jusum narafala pikja mo tapim bed ya. Blong klirem wan bed, tapim hem taem i nogat pikja we i selektem.
Tapim "Start again" blong klirem evri bed, mo "Put it back" sapos yu jenisem tingting blong yu.
Tapim "Print the plan" blong gat wan pepa kopi blong plot mo samari.
tips: Talk about each picture as it goes in, such as "the sunflower goes by the birdhouse". Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let each person choose a picture in turn, or choose the pictures together, so both have a say in the plot.
On paper, the blank beds are for drawing in your own ideas, and the notes lines are for anything you want to remember.

faq.q: Is this planting advice?
faq.a: No. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. It does not say when, where or how to plant anything, because that depends on where you live.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored, rated or counted, and nobody wins. A full plot gets no special message.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The plan stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the plan" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the twelve beds with the pictures you chose, the summary in words, and blank lines for notes.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. The wall is simply a picture that many people colored.

faq.q: Are the pages saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The wall is made on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Do the colors have to match?
faq.a: No. Every person can use any colors and any style. The pages still join up into one picture.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. The printed wall is the whole game: a first page with the steps and a map, and one page for each part of the picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Turn on the hint lines to see each space. Turn them off for more of a puzzle, with only the outline to go by.
Start with the big shapes, such as the large triangles and the rectangles. The small pieces often go last.
Name the shapes out loud as you go: "a triangle, a square, a long rectangle". Talking can make it something you do together.
On paper, colour the pieces with two or three colours, or cut them out with an adult helping.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a move count?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, counted or scored. A piece that does not fit is simply not placed, and you can stop whenever you like.

faq.q: Is anything we make saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The picture stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Are the places big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: The outline is drawn as large as the screen allows, and each space is a button you can reach with a finger or with the Tab key. The pieces in the tray are the large buttons of the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print this shape" prints one picture on one page: the outline with its hint lines, and the pieces drawn at the same size beside it. Colour the pieces, or cut them out to fit. An adult can do the cutting.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

calm-breathing.name: Pulum win kwaet
calm-breathing.seoTitle: A Calm Breathing Pause to Share
calm-breathing.h1: Wan kwaet taem blong pulum win
calm-breathing.description: Wan sloslo mo kwaet taem blong pulum win tugeta: wan sotfala raonwan sekol i kam bigwan mo kam smol blong sikis taem blong pulum win.
calm-breathing.short: Wan sekol we i muv sloslo blong pulum win folem hem. Statem mo stopem taem yu wantem.
calm-breathing.intro: Samtaem, bes samting blong mekem hem i blong stap kwaet lelebet nomo. Tajem "Start", biaen pulum win taem sekol i kam bigwan mo letem win i go aot taem hem i kam smol. Jusum spid we i sloslo o isi. Hem i no wan tritmen, hem i wan kwaet taem nomo blong stap tugeta.
howTo: Sidaon gud klosap long tufala.
Jusum spid: sloslo o isi nomo.
Tajem "Start". Pulum win taem sekol i kam bigwan, mo letem win i go aot taem hem i kam smol.
Hem i stopem hem wan afta sikis taem blong pulum win, o tajem "Stop" taem yu wantem.
tips: Holem han o putum han long han blong man ya sipos hem i glad long hem.
Neva fosem hem. Sipos hem i wantem lukluk nomo, hemia i oraet nomo.
Sipos wan man i gat problem blong pulum win, pulum win olsem we yu stap mekem mo lukluk nomo long sekol ya. Toktok wetem wan dokta long eni wari long saed blong pulum win.

faq.q: Hemia wan eksasaes blong pulum win blong medisin?
faq.a: No. Hem i wan isi taem nomo blong spel blong mekem tingting i kwaet mo blong stap tugeta. Hem i no wan tritmen blong wari tumas o eni sik. Toktok wetem wan dokta long saed blong eni wari long helt.

faq.q: Sekol ya i muv hem wan nomo we mi no statem?
faq.a: No. I no gat samting we i muv kasem taem yu tajem Start, mo hem i stop afta long sikis pulum win o taem yu tajem Stop. Sipos divaes blong yu i set blong katem daon muvman, ol wod oli jenis be sekil ya i no kam bigwan.

faq.q: Hem i fri, mo mi nid blong saenap?
faq.a: Yes, hem i fri nomo, mo i no gat wan akaon, saenap o daonlod. Hem i wok nomo long web braosa long wan fon, tablet o kompiuta.

story-chain.name: Story chain
story-chain.seoTitle: Story Chain: a Shared Picture Story Game
story-chain.h1: Story Chain: Tell a Story One Picture at a Time
story-chain.description: A row of pictures grows one at a time, and each person says a sentence about it aloud. Nothing to type, no right answer. Free, calm, no timer and no score.
story-chain.short: Add a picture, then say a sentence each, taking turns.
story-chain.intro: The game starts with one picture and grows the chain one picture at a time. Each person says one sentence about the chain so far, out loud, in turn. A sentence can be about what you see, a place it brings to mind, or something silly. Nothing is typed, recorded or kept, there is no right answer, and anyone may pass. The chain stops at eight pictures, and then you can start a new one.
howTo: Look at the first picture together.
Take turns: each person says one sentence about the chain so far. Anyone may pass.
Tap "Add a picture" to put the next picture at the end of the chain.
Tap "Take the last one off" if you would rather go back a picture.
When the chain has eight pictures, tap "Start a new chain" for a fresh one, or simply stop.
tips: Short is fine: "Someone put the kettle on." The next person carries on, or passes.
Let the pictures lead. There is no story you are meant to arrive at.
Stop whenever you like. Stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is anything typed or recorded?
faq.a: No. The sentences are spoken aloud and are not typed, recorded or sent anywhere. The game only shows the pictures.

faq.q: What if someone does not want to say anything?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and the next person goes on. Nobody has to name or remember a picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-scene.name: Quiet scene
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Quiet Scene: One Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.h1: Quiet Scene: One Still Picture at a Time
quiet-scene.description: One large, still picture at a time, each with one gentle line under it. Press Next or Previous when you are ready. Nothing moves or plays on its own, and there is no timer or score. Free to play, with no account.
quiet-scene.short: Look at one still picture at a time, at your own pace.
quiet-scene.players: Alone, or a group in the same room
quiet-scene.intro: One large picture fills the screen, with one short line under it. Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready for another. Nothing moves, fades or changes on its own, and nothing is timed. Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, so the whole room can see it on a television.
howTo: Look at the picture together.
Read the line under it aloud if you like.
Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready.
Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, and "Show everything" to bring the rest back.
Stop whenever you like with "Done for now".
tips: Let the person choose when to move on: wait for them to look, then press Next.
For a group, use "Bigger picture" on a television or large screen and sit where everyone can see it.
There is no right way to look at a picture. Simply talking about one is a complete activity.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does it play sound or move?
faq.a: No. There is no sound, and nothing moves, fades or changes by itself. A picture changes only when you press a button.

faq.q: Ya, i gat wan paper version?
faq.a: Nogat. Hemia wan pija blong lukluk tugeta long wan skrin. Wan fevret foto o postcard long taebol i save mekem sem wok.

faq.q: Hem i fri, mo yumi mas rejista o nogat?
faq.a: Yes, hem i fri, mo nogat akaont, rejistrasen o daonlod. Hem i wok long web browser long fon, tablet o kompiuta.

color-wash.name: Kala wash
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Sɔft Kala Oa Wan Pej
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Pentem Sɔft Kala Oa Wan Pej
color-wash.description: Wan sɔft brɔs i pentem gulfala wai kala we yu save luk thru long wan pej, long fo kala mo tu saes blong brɔs. Nogat wan en pɔjnt, nogat skoa, mo nogat taem blong stopem. Fri blong pleim, nogat akaont.
color-wash.short: Pentem sɔft wash blong kala oa wan pej, long stret blong yu.
color-wash.players: Yu wan, o 2 man i stap sanaed
color-wash.intro: Wan pej mo wan sɔft brɔs. Yu jusum wan kala mo wan saes blong brɔs, lakem then dragem brɔs oa long pej blong mekem wan wash blong kala. Pej ia i nogat wan en pɔjnt: i nogat wan samting blong finisim, nogat piksa blong mekem stret, mo nogat skoa. Yu save mekem olsem planti wash we yu wantem, o yu save putum brɔs daon mo jus lukluk. Wan niu pej i klirim evri samting, mo Putum bak i kasem ol wash ia bak.
howTo: Jusum wan kala. Kala i gat nem we i stap long raetem.
Jusum Wide o Very wide. Very wide i kavremap moa pej long wan strok.
Dragem oa long pej wetem fingga, mouse o pen blong mekem wan wash.
O yusum ol arrow key blong muvum ring blong brɔs, mo Space blong putum brɔs daon o antap.
Tajem "A fresh page" blong klirim pej, then "Put it back" sapos yu wantem ol wash ia bak.
tips: Letem narafala man i jusum kala blong nekis wash, mo toktok abaot ol kala taem oli stap kam aot.
Very wide i isi moa blong kontrolem sapos han i stap sek, from brɔs i no nidim i stret tru.
Nogat wan stret wei blong pentem. Stop taem yu wantem, o tajem "Done for now".

faq.q: Ya, i gat wan finis, skoa o taem?
faq.a: Nogat. Pej i nogat wan en pɔjnt. Nogat wan samting i finis, kaontem, taemem o skoa, mo nogat mesej we i askem yu blong mekem moa.

faq.q: Ya, pej i sev o i sendem?
faq.a: Nogat. Nogat samting i sev, printem o sendem we. Ol wash i stap long pej ia kasem taem yu lusim hem.

faq.q: Ya, mi save yusum hemia nogat mouse o taj skrin?
faq.a: Yes. Taem pej i gat fokas, ol arrow key i muvum ring blong brɔs, mo Space key i putum brɔs daon o antap. Skrin i talem "Brush down" o "Brush up" evri taem.

faq.q: Ya, i gat wan pepa version?
faq.a: Nogat. Watercolor long pepa i sem tingting, wan wet brɔs mo wan kala long wan taem, so hemia wan narafala wok blong traem long taebol.

faq.q: Wanem nao ol kala ia?
faq.a: Yelo, oranis, grin mo pepol, ol sem fo kala we yumi yusum long ol narafala pija gem blong mifala. Each i gat nem we i stap long raetem, mo nem ia i sho bisaed long jois.

faq.q: Hem i fri, mo yumi mas rejista o nogat?
faq.a: Yes, hem i fri, mo nogat akaont, rejistrasen o daonlod. Hem i wok long web browser long fon, tablet o kompiuta.
